methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 freestanding, exhaust-vented portable AC models, each a standalone portable unit (not a window unit or mini-split). Specs were re-verified against manufacturer product pages (Midea US, LG USA, GE Appliances, De'Longhi US, Black+Decker, Frigidaire, Honeywell Store, SereneLife, Whynter, Hisense USA), major retailers (Lowe's, Best Buy, Walmart, Home Depot, Abt, AJ Madison, Town Appliance, Target), and independent corroboration (Rtings, ConsumerAnalysis, TechGearLab, DealNews). cooling_btu_ashrae uses the legacy ASHRAE-128 chamber standard; cooling_btu_sacc uses the 2019 DOE SACC/CEC standard; booleans (heat_mode, smart_wifi) are true only when explicitly listed by the manufacturer ('Follow Me'/remote thermostats are NOT counted as smart_wifi); noise_dba is the highest published fan-speed figure unless a single value is given. Where a model is discontinued and no live published US price exists, priceUsd is null rather than a stale guess. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Midea Duo MAP14HS1TBL
products.priceNote: Best Buy listed price; Midea US store ~$660 with promo
products.provenance: Midea US store + Best Buy + Lowe's + Amazon confirm 14,000 BTU ASHRAE / 12,000 BTU SACC / 550 sq ft / dual hose-in-hose / heat mode (4-in-1) / WiFi (Alexa/Google) / 42 dBA. Best Buy listed $679; Midea US ~$660 with promo. Verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: LG LP1419IVSM
products.provenance: LG USA page confirms 14,000 BTU ASHRAE / 10,000 BTU SACC / 500 sq ft / Wi-Fi (ThinQ, Alexa/Google) / single hose / no heat (cool/fan/dry only). DUAL Inverter = compressor tech, not dual hose. Coverage 500 per LG.com (some retailer mirrors quote 450; manufacturer figure kept). Noise 44 dBA low / 53 dBA high (Rtings/AJ Madison); 53 used as max. MSRP $699 (Abt/Town; Best Buy $649-$699). Verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: Whynter ARC-14S
products.priceNote: Walmart/Best Buy retail $499.99; street price fluctuates seasonally
products.provenance: Amazon/Best Buy/Walmart confirm 14,000 BTU ASHRAE / 9,500 BTU SACC / 500 sq ft / dual hose / no heat / no WiFi. Noise under 56 dBA on high. Price $499.99 (Walmart/Best Buy). One Zoro spec sheet shows 8,884.5 SACC, but 9,500 is the dominant published figure. No official release year. Verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: Black+Decker BPACT14WT
products.priceNote: Current market price; original MSRP higher; a junk $1,428.99 marketplace listing was disregarded
products.provenance: blackanddecker.com + Walmart confirm 14,000 BTU ASHRAE / 7,700 BTU SACC/CEC / 700 sq ft (ASHRAE-era marketing capacity) / single hose / no heat / no WiFi. The 'Smart'/'Follow Me' label is a remote thermostat, not WiFi app control, so smart_wifi=false. A heat variant (BPACT14HWT) exists and is correctly excluded. noise_dba not published; null. Verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: De'Longhi Pinguino Plus PACEL376HGRFK
products.priceNote: US MSRP per multiple US retailers; brief specified PACEL375 (CA-region only) — closest current US equivalent is PACEL376HGRFK
products.provenance: Brief model PACEL375 is a Canada/region variant (delonghi.com/en-ca, 500 sq ft, no US WiFi SKU); current US Pinguino Plus equivalent on De'Longhi US, Amazon, and Home Depot is PACEL376HGRFK. Confirmed 12,500 BTU ASHRAE / 7,200 BTU SACC / 550 sq ft / single hose / heat (4-in-1) / WiFi (Alexa). MSRP $649 per US retailers. noise_dba not published; null. Verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: Frigidaire FHPC132AB1
products.priceNote: Regular retail price (Town Appliance/Appliance Advantage); seen on sale ~$467; model discontinued
products.provenance: Frigidaire page + AJ Madison + BrandsMart confirm 13,000 BTU ASHRAE / 8,000 BTU DOE-SACC / 600 sq ft (10.5 EER, 7.2 CEER) / cool-only / single hose / no WiFi. Noise 49-52 dBA; 52 (high) used. Discontinued, replaced by GHPC132AB1. Regular price $519; on sale ~$467. Verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: Honeywell MN4CFS9
products.priceNote: Discontinued — shows Sold Out / $0.00 on Honeywell Store; no live published US price, so null
products.provenance: Official Honeywell Store listing for MN4CFS9 confirms dual hose (12-47 in exhaust hose), 14,000 BTU ASHRAE / 9,000 BTU SACC / 700 sq ft / 54 dBA / no heat / no WiFi. Model is discontinued and listed as Sold Out / $0.00, so priceUsd set to null (the prior $579.99 is no longer a live published US price). One aggregator spec page mislabels it single-hose; the manufacturer store (dual hose) governs. Verified 2026-06-19.

products.name: GE APCA14YBMW
products.priceNote: MSRP $549 (sale $540) per GE Appliances; model discontinued
